title: Chapter 487
paragraphs: Chapter 487
Episode 135. Brotherly Unity (4)
The troops of Runcandel and Kinzelo, who did not come to the Gaipa military road, had set up a camp in the Sota Desert while Jin was meeting with Amella.

Just as Joshua had formed a tunnel in the desert underground using the power of the prophet, Kinzelo had also used their own abilities to create scout passages, and secretly utilized part of Joshua's tunnel.
Jin's gaze fell on the head of the dead construction site manager.
The cut on the neck area was messy as if it had been torn. A trace that did not fit infiltration and assassination at all.

'Besides, the explosion is loud even though the distance is considerable. It's not something that happened while dealing with a sudden situation after infiltration, but they openly attacked the construction site.'
It seemed that Kinzelo had decided to approach the secret construction site of the Sota Desert in a completely different way from Runcandel.
'What is the basis for Kinzelo's confidence? There must be something they strongly believe in.'
The Sota Desert is adjacent to the capital of the Lutero Magic Federation, Drakka.
It meant that Runcandel did not choose an infiltration operation for no reason. Kinzelo was poking a dangerous hornet's nest with great confidence.
"Considering that our information couldn't have been leaked, the fact that the operation started at the same time... Is it just a damn coincidence?"
While Jin began to think, Joshua gritted his teeth and scowled.
Boom, crackle-! Thud! Rumble!

As if waiting for Runcandel to arrive, the explosion grew louder as soon as Joshua finished speaking. The vibration that spread from inside the construction site seemed like the tunnel would collapse at any moment.
In this case.
Runcandel was completely messed up from the start. Mixed with the explosion, the madly ringing alarm sound of the security magic scraped the party's nerves.
Jin had been calculating how to kill Joshua and succeed in the mission since last night, but he did not expect this sudden terror from Kinzelo.
'However, it might not be such a bad development. At least for me and Brother Difus.'
Jin was certain that Joshua had 'information that he did not share with him and Difus' regarding this mission.
As he had told Difus earlier, the 4th, 11th, 17th, and 19th areas marked on the construction site's internal structure diagram were meaningless.

'Joshua must have been certain that Difus and I would naively choose one of those four areas to check. Because we would have to interfere anyway in order to destroy the construction site. And he would have tried to go to the real information site alone, secretly from Difus and me during the chaos.'
Jin had speculated that the location of the information Joshua was trying to monopolize was '2nd Magic Tower.'
There is not only Drakka near the Sota Desert construction site. Not too far away, there is also the 'Tower of White Night,' the 2nd Magic Tower of Ziepfl.
Of course, it was speculation that Joshua was trying to monopolize the information of the 2nd Magic Tower.

So, once the infiltration began, Jin intended to keep an eye on Joshua with Difus. Deliberately mentioning the 2nd Magic Tower or choosing to search only the areas closest to the 2nd Magic Tower within the construction site.

"The possibility that Zieph prepared all the confidential documents in the 2nd Tower in anticipation of the infiltration is low. With Drakka right in front of them, it would be difficult to think that we or Kinjero would touch the 2nd Tower. Both destroying the drying plant would be enough of a burden..."
Ah!
At that moment, as he thought about it, a shiver ran down his spine.
The puzzle of intuition was solved.

"There's no need to watch Joshua, the 2nd Tower is certain. The Kinjero bastards are drawing attention to bring support from the 2nd Tower's forces to the drying plant, and then they plan to rob the empty house!"
The reason Kinjero was blatantly terrorizing the drying plant.
They were aware of the fact that the really important information existed outside the drying plant, specifically in the 2nd Tower.
Furthermore.
"Damn Kinjero bastards! Did they also figure out that the blueprints of the ship are partially in the 2nd Tower, not in the drying plant?"
Joshua was the same.
However, unlike Kinjero, who was confidently smashing the drying plant, he felt a cold sensation that melted his liver.
"There's no way it's a coincidence that they started the terror to match our infiltration time! Information about the operation and the 2nd Tower has been leaked. I don't know what route it took...!"
Now, Joshua had originally planned for Jin, Murakan, and Difus to take care of the acts that Kinjero was currently using to draw attention with the terror.
Meanwhile, he planned to slip away to the 2nd Tower at the right time.
He thought it wouldn't be too difficult to deceive his brothers and Murakan since the underground drying plant was incredibly vast.
So, he was thrilled when he confirmed that Jin and Murakan had arrived instead of Meri yesterday. What a situation this is!
In the midst of the distant explosions and the silence in between, the gaze of the Rune Candel party gathered on Joshua.
It was the silent pressure to make a judgment as the highest decision-maker in this matter.
The anxiety that Kinjero might be one step ahead, the pressure to recalculate everything from the beginning, and the emotionless face of his youngest brother in front of him.
Because of those factors, Joshua was barely able to hide his expression.
"I need to stay calm for now. If I show even a hint of panic, the youngest one will definitely catch the scent. He never misses a hint, never."
No matter how careful he was, he had no idea that Jin had already read his moves.
And Joshua wasn't the only one feeling the burn inside.

"Considering the scale of Kinjero's terror, the destruction of the drying plant is practically over. Moreover, as the youngest said, the importance of the four areas Joshua insisted on is just an illusion to deceive us. So, it's right for Joshua to make a withdrawal judgment now..."
Difus also felt his mouth go dry as he recalled the conversation he had with Jin last night.
-Didn't I say earlier that there would be nothing important in areas 4, 11, 17, and 19?
-Yes, as you said, since Zipline intentionally leaked the location of the construction site, it's unlikely that important information like the ship's blueprint would be left here.
-But there must be important information somewhere near the construction site. Obviously, most of it would be in Drakka, but we can't touch that, so the most likely place is the 2nd Tower.

-So, you're saying that the real important information is not in the construction site, but in the 2nd Tower, and Joshua wants to infiltrate the construction site with us and take the information from the 2nd Tower alone?
-That's right.

-Hmm, let's say you're right. But our big brother is certainly a garbage-like person, but he's not foolish enough to jeopardize the family's big victory for personal gains. It was just a while ago that he manipulated the media to give you articles during the Black King's Party crisis.
-That's true. However, Joshua may have decided that it's better to deceive us as well to obtain information from the 2nd Tower securely, right?

-That's possible. But little brother, your claim is just a possibility without any solid evidence. It's just speculation. Moreover, even if the speculation is true, what does it have to do with killing Joshua?

-When we go to the 2nd Tower, Joshua won't take both Black Knights with him. At least one person should be left at the construction site. To deceive us and buy time. But we'll secretly go to the 2nd Tower as well, leaving only one Black Knight in the vast underground construction site.
-And then we'll strike Joshua, who is with the one Black Knight?
-We'll strike when Joshua has secured the information from the 2nd Tower. If we're lucky, he might leave both Black Knights at the construction site and go alone.
-What if, unfortunately, a Black Knight remains by Joshua's side in the 2nd Tower?
-We can still kill him easily since we have Murakan.

-No, I mean how will we handle the Black Knight? Even though we have Murakan, it's impossible to subdue the Black Knight without killing him. Also, killing a Black Knight is a completely different issue from killing Joshua.
-Well, it's closer to rebellion than a power struggle.

-It's not just close. Killing a Black Knight during such an important mission? That's definitely a rebellion. It's kind of disappointing, your speculation has too many variables. I thought you had a really solid hand.

-It's about killing the 2nd generation of Runcandel. And the one known as the next family head. If you can't handle this kind of risk, you can't even try it for a lifetime. And you might never get such a dangerous opportunity again.
-Sigh.
-And I don't intend to kill the Black Knight. I didn't expect my second brother to be so scared. If you want to back out, go ahead.
-...First, after infiltrating, let's keep an eye on Joshua while searching the area closest to the 2nd Tower.
In fact, Diphus had been struggling to suppress his troubled heart since the conversation yesterday.

He felt disappointed to the point of being devastated by both his youngest brother, who said he would kill Joshua based on flimsy speculation, and himself, who hastily agreed to join the plan out of desperation.
'But if Joshua chooses to continue the mission instead of withdrawing, that means... the youngest's leap of logic was true...!'
Joshua and Diphus.
Unlike the two, Jin had already cleared his confused mind and was calculating other variables.

'Kinjello, those bastards have helped me again this time. You'll choose to proceed, Joshua. It must be embarrassing enough to want to die, but as Diphus said, you won't give up the family's great victory.'
He hid his smile.
It was because his speculation was getting closer to the truth, but he hadn't completely won yet.
"Ah, it's so frustrating. Hey!"
Suddenly, Murakan yelled out Joshua's name with an annoyed voice.

"Aren't you the decision-maker? Make a decision quickly. Will you continue the mission or not? Why are you standing there staring blankly? I'm busy! If you want to return, let's go back quickly. I want to see my strawberry pie."
In the end, Joshua had no choice but to answer like this.
"…We will proceed with the mission."
Thump!
As soon as he heard the decision, Diphus felt his heart pounding like a hammer.
He was shocked. He couldn't even fathom how many steps ahead the youngest was looking.
'Right, I was suspicious for no reason. I can kill Joshua if I just follow the youngest's plan!'
This time, Jin was watching Diphus's disappointment turning into anticipation, and as expected, he felt somewhat regretful.
'If he knew that the current Joshua is not the real one, how disappointed would he be? I feel a little sorry.'
